title: Industrial growth boundary change in Bill 139
summary: The ranch's consultant said the land would be used for recycling, waste processing and light industry. The project also needs a zoning change, which requires final approval by the County Council. The Maui Planning Commission reviewed the bill on May 27, 2025, and recommended approval.
